limitations: Provider usage limits interrupted early cohorts for hours; intervals are not active runtime and cannot establish speed/cost advantage.
Filesystem execution permissions changed globally during interruptions. Same requested conditions do not establish identical provider/runtime conditions across all runs.
Requested18-minute budgets and two aesthetic rounds are instructions, not hard provider limits.
Exact model version, tokens, tool-call counts and calibrated active runtime are unavailable.
Booking model assessments cover five critical states at both widths; complete20-view galleries remain available for human review.
Solid-background contrast, targets and occlusion measurements are approximate observations, not a complete accessibility audit.
Finance trial1 candidate has22 more repeated contrast-warning observations than current, including secondary copy at4.38–4.40:1; no manual app edits were made to hide it.
Control finance trials1and3 have one mobile scroll-content occlusion observation each; scrollReview is not proof the action is unreachable.
Builder baseline contact originals were overwritten by contact sheets in one trial; independent captures of the unchanged starting fixture provide matching original views.
One coordinator capture overlapped a rebuild and failed with HTTP navigation error; preserved and rerun after completed build.
Browser suite had one transient500ms CLI fixture failure; isolated retry passed, test now uses supported3000ms default with the same strict error assertions.
Initial optional showcase/chat invocation omitted configured browser executable and failed before browser work; configured runs are recorded separately.
releaseRecommendation: HOLD for native activation, controlled model/environment budgets and independent human assessment; no design superiority claim
